description: Na₃VBSiO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.50 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.79 Å. V is bonded to six O atoms to form VO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.87-2.09 Å. B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.34-1.43 Å. Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent VO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 32-41°. There are two shorter (1.64 Å) and two longer (1.65 Å) Si-O bond lengths. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one B atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one V, and one B atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one V, and one B atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one V, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one V, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one V, and one Si atom.
